$comment: D7 activity_ready: explicit only (no auto-ready for snowboard-race). Requires the seated player to have completed the load handshake with the exact server course hash. Allowed in lobby/results; ready=false during countdown cancels it. In results, ready=true is the rematch vote.
name: ready
invariants: ready without a matching loaded handshake is rejected not_loaded
ready during countdown (ready=false) cancels the countdown, clears ALL readiness, returns the lobby
all seated connected riders ready with count >= 2 locks the roster and schedules the 3s countdown
ready expires after readyExpirySeconds without a start
every correlated ready acknowledgment echoes requestId + serverNow + room/session identity for clock correlation
